stateNote: Bake the quiche for about 90 minutes, checking every so often. The quiche is done when it's browned on top and it jiggles slightly like a properly set custard when you shake the pan. If it still looks quite liquid, it probably needs more time. If it's hard, puffed up a lot, and doesn't really jiggle, it might be overbaked. Adjust the time and temperature accordingly for your oven.
